name: claude-mem
description: Persistent memory for AI coding agents: the next session starts where the last one left off. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and more.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent memory: the next session starts where the last one left off.
interface.longDescription: While you work, an observer watches what Codex reads, edits and runs, and writes short notes called observations. The next session starts with a compact index of the ones that matter, so you stop re-explaining the codebase and re-discovering decisions.
defaultPrompt: Find what I already learned about this codebase before I start a new task.
Show recent observations related to the files I am editing right now.
Summarize the last session and inject the most relevant context into this one.
